title: Hear the Candidates
description: Before you sign the appointments, bring the leading candidates into the cabinet room. Hear them present their visions. Let them argue. Test them. The decisions you make afterwards will define your government.

title: The Ministers
description: The cabinet must be formally appointed before the end of the week — parliament is watching the list. Vyktor has prepared candidate pairs for the five discretionary positions. Four configurations are ready for your review.

title: The First Roundtable
description: Your appointed cabinet meets for the first time. Each minister states their priorities.

title: A Difficult Afternoon
description: Jonas called. Tomas came home from school early. He won't say what happened, but Jonas's voice when he told you suggested it was serious.

title: Budget Allocation — Initial Framework
description: Before the cabinet is fully seated, establish the fiscal framework that will define your government's priorities. Vostane has prepared preliminary revenue and expenditure projections.

title: Meet the Reformist Caucus
description: Professor Theron's reformist bloc wants an early meeting. They backed your nomination and they want to know what they bought with their votes.

title: The Bureau's Files
description: Danika Oberlin has completed her initial sweep of the BNI's active files. Some of what she found cannot wait for a scheduled briefing.
